title: Internal: Repair local check command
body:
## What I did

Continuation of the `yarn build` fix PR. This PR fixes `yarn check`, also improves the handling of `--watch` and implements a global watch mode on top of TS diagnostics using watchpack (which is already a direct dep).

I settled on this approach to watch mode to ensure that we never forget to check a package that depends on types from another package. It's slow, but reliable and reasonably fast to implement.

## Checklist for Contributors

### Testing

#### Manual testing

```ts
cd code
yarn check
yarn check --watch
yarn check storybook
yarn check --watch storybook addon-docs
```

comments.author: coderabbitai
comments.label_reasoning: The comment primarily identifies a race condition caused by using forEach with async callbacks, which fires all package checks concurrently without proper sequencing, leading to interleaved output and uncontrolled execution order.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment identifies multiple concrete issues: race conditions from forEach+async, interleaved output, dead code (watchMode ternary in else branch), and explicitly suggests replacing forEach with a for...of loop with await. A full code suggestion is provided.
